column7: The core TOTP refusal under fips140=only (fips-totp-hmac-sha1-panic-001) is mapped by writeMFAErr, the VerifyMFA unavailable branch, MFAStepUp, writeWebAuthnErr, sendMFAResetError and UpdateOwnProfile to a fixed 503 "TOTP is not available in FIPS mode; use a recovery code or a passkey" instead of a 500 or a panic; the test drives every mapper in default mode.
